messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected on /streaming/generate (p99 > 2s). auto-escalation to #incidents. start_ts=2008001234
jamal (oncall): I see it — p95 jumped to ~700ms, p99 ~2.8s across streaming route. Rolling windows show spike started ~2008001205. Anyone touching prefix-hash rollout? :eyes:
maria (eng-runtime): we rolled a prefix-hash change at 2008001100 in canary, then promoted at 2008001150. I pushed a minor change to prefix hashing keys (stable->entropy-v2) to address collisions. Could be related.
alex (eng-sre): Confirming elevated cache miss rate. From our metrics: `prefix_cache_hit_rate` dropped from 92% -> 28% on routing tier for live region-us-east-1 between 2008001150-2008001220.
ops-bot: svc_streaming.frontend latency p95=710ms p99=2820ms; cache_miss_rate=72% on prefix-cache.
jamal (oncall): Ok. Primary hypothesis: rollout changed key hashing -> broad invalidation -> cache warmup failure -> tail latency. Impact: degraded streaming tail and some requests spilled to slower path (paging to KV/paging nodes).
kevin (support): On the support side, we're seeing ~8 customer tickets with 'slow responses' flagged; two customers reported production impact (timeout retries). I'll mark this P1 customer-affecting and loop CS.
sara (eng-platform): any quick mitigation we can do without full rollback? Maybe enable fallback to old-hash variant or temporarily increase prefetch window / cache TTL.
maria (eng-runtime): We have a feature flag `prefix.hash_variant` can be rolled back per region. Options: roll back to `entropy-v1` or enable hybrid fallback that probes old keys on miss. Quick test: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/prefix.hash_variant -d '{"value":"entropy-v1","scope":"us-east-1"}'`
jamal (oncall): Try hybrid fallback first (safer) — if we can probe old keys before paging it might reduce misses. Maria, do you have endpoint?
maria (eng-runtime): spinning up a canary with fallback probe now. Patch applied to canary routers: will probe old-hash for first 3s of a miss. Patching config:```json
{
  "prefix_probe": {
    "enabled": true,
    "probe_timeout_ms": 3000,
    "old_variant": "entropy-v1"
  }
}```
ops-bot: canary logs: probe hit rate ~65% for misses, average extra latency on probe 20-30ms. If probe succeeds we avoid paging for many requests.
jamal (oncall): That looks promising — can we scale probe to all routers in us-east-1? What's the risk?
maria (eng-runtime): Risk: small added CPU and one additional KV read per miss. Benefit: avoids multi-hop paging. I'll roll to 50% of routers now then monitor.
alex (eng-sre): Rolling to 50% now. Metrics: after 50% roll (2008001345) p95 dropped to 420ms, p99 to 980ms, cache miss rate down to 46%.
product-alerts-bot: Noted degraded SLA. Creating incident ticket IN-2008, severity=P2 (customer impact).
jamal (oncall): Good improvement. Next steps: keep probe on cluster for 1 hour, if stable we can either keep hybrid or roll back hash promotion. Maria please prepare rollback plan for entropy-v1 promotion in case probe isn't enough.
maria (eng-runtime): Rollback plan ready: revert flag to `entropy-v1` global -> requires config push and router restart @ low-traffic window. Duration ~3-5min, risk minimal. Also preparing cache-warm job to pre-seed prefixes used by our top 10 customers (script ready).
kevin (support): Notifying the two impacted customers with status update: "We're mitigating a performance regression; routing fallback applied; expected improvement in <30 mins."
jamal (oncall): Monitoring for next 30m. If p99 < 1s and miss_rate < 50% we keep probe and kick off warm-up. If not, we'll rollback.
ops-bot: 2008001400 metrics snapshot: p95=410ms p99=880ms miss_rate=44% (us-east-1), streaming throughput nominal.
alex (eng-sre): I've kicked off the cache-warm job that primes ~120k prefixes for top customers. Job id=warm-2008001405. It will run at low QPS to avoid overload.
maria (eng-runtime): Warm job started. Also enabling slightly higher cache TTL for these prefixes to 15m for the warm window. Config: `prefix.cache_ttl_override = 900` seconds.
jamal (oncall): Customer impact update: severity lowered — no more new timeouts in last 12 minutes. Support, keep watch on replies. Ops, keep monitoring SLOs and alert if p99 > 1.5s.
ops-bot: 2008001500 snapshot: p95=380ms p99=720ms miss_rate=32% after warm job progress ~40%.
kevin (support): CS confirms one customer re-tested and reports normal performance. I'll close the P1 notes and keep ticket linked to incident.
jamal (oncall): Great. We'll keep the hybrid probe + warm job for the next 60 minutes. Maria, prepare a post-incident blameless write-up describing rollout testing gap and steps to prevent auto-invalidations (maybe a canary that monitors live cache-hit-rate on promote). Add follow-ups: stronger canary gating (monitor prefix_hit_rate delta), automated rollback on >30% miss spike, and a pre-warm hook as part of promotion.
maria (eng-runtime): Will do. Adding an action: create immediate CI job that simulates production prefix distribution and verifies no catastrophic hit-rate drop before promote.
alex (eng-sre): handoff: I'm on until 2008001600 then jamal takes back. Current status: steady improvement, watching for regressions.
jamal (oncall): acknowledged. Thanks all for the rapid assist. Will create incident timeline and tag engineering leads for postmortem. :thumbsup:
product-alerts-bot: Incident IN-2008 updated: status=mitigated -> monitoring, duration=~28m to mitigation threshold.
